headline: Fitch Assigns Suriname 'B-' Sovereign Rating with Positive Outlook
summary: Fitch Ratings assigned Suriname an indicative sovereign rating of B- with a positive outlook. The agency cited anticipated offshore crude oil production slated to begin in 2028 as the primary catalyst behind the favorable rating trajectory.
why: Suriname has been recovering from a comprehensive debt restructuring, with newly discovered deepwater petroleum reserves expected to transform government revenues.

impacts.name: Suriname
impacts.why: A positive sovereign credit rating outlook reduces external borrowing risk and enhances fiscal credibility.
